changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'VersionStepTransition') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [workflow].[VersionStepTransition]( [FromVersionStepID] [int] NOT NULL, [ToVersionStepID] [int] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [TransitionType] [int] NOT NULL, [Condition] [xml] NULL, [FromPortID] [varchar](10) NULL, [ToPortID] [varchar](10) NULL, [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Settings] [xml] NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_WorkflowVersionStepTransition_State] DEFAULT (-1) NOT NULL, [TimerLastRunDate] [datetime] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_WorkflowVersionStepTransition] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowVersionStepTransition_FromVersionStep') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[VersionStepTransition] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowVersionStepTransition_FromVersionStep] FOREIGN KEY([FromVersionStepID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[VersionStep] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [workflow].[VersionStepTransition] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowVersionStepTransition_FromVersionStep] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowVersionStepTransition_ToVersionStep') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[VersionStepTransition] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowVersionStepTransition_ToVersionStep] FOREIGN KEY([ToVersionStepID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[VersionStep] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [workflow].[VersionStepTransition] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowVersionStepTransition_ToVersionStep] END
